verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents building on-call schedules from standard rotation templates, a complex-schedules guide that combines EU, US West, and Asia/Pacific schedules for 24/7 follow-the-sun coverage, one-click overrides and cover requests, and Google/Outlook calendar sync. That covers rotations and time zones, but the evidence never mentions schedule layers or round-robin coverage, so only part of the story is shown. Missing for 10: explicit schedule layers, round-robin rotation or assignment, detailed rotation configuration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
